label: Product report
description: Emails the product summary to the recipients listed in the Report Pilot app settings each time a report is generated.
subject: Products: {{ period_label }} — {% assign rp_n = products_sold_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %} sold{% if unsold_count != nil %}, {% assign rp_n = unsold_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %} with no sales{% endif %}

fields.label: Footer note
fields.default: You're receiving this because your address is listed as a recipient in the Report Pilot app settings. Change how often the product report is sent, turn it off, or remove your address there.
